# Claude Code config: long-running primitives

Example implementations of the long-running primitives as native Claude Code hooks. Copy `.claude/` into your project as a starting point and adapt the file paths and matching rules to fit.

**Requires:** `bash`, `git`, `python3` (the hooks parse JSON via python3; without it they silently no-op).

```bash
cp -r .claude/ /path/to/your/project/
chmod +x /path/to/your/project/.claude/hooks/*.sh
cd /path/to/your/project && claude
```

| File | Primitive |
|---|---|
| `.claude/hooks/kill-switch.sh` | Halt every tool call while `./AGENT_STOP` exists |
| `.claude/hooks/steer.sh` | Surface `./STEER.md` content to the agent once, then clear it |
| `.claude/hooks/track-read.sh` + `verify-gate.sh` | Deny marking a test passing until evidence (screenshot/console log) has been Read |
| `.claude/hooks/commit-on-stop.sh` | Commit at the end of every session |
| `.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Progress-file convention, one-feature-at-a-time, proof-before-passing |

The verify gate guards a results file you create in your project (default name `test-results.json`; override with `RESULTS_FILE`). Shape it however you like; the hook only cares that the file exists and that the agent opened evidence before touching it. A minimal starting point:

```json
{ "feature-1": { "passes": false }, "feature-2": { "passes": false } }
```

The gate tracks evidence at the session level (any screenshot opened unlocks one write). For per-test evidence tracking, extend `track-read.sh` to record which test ID each screenshot belongs to and have `verify-gate.sh` match on that.

For unattended multi-session runs, pair this config with the [`ralph-loop`](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official/tree/main/plugins/ralph-loop) plugin or a wrapper script that calls `claude -p "continue from PROGRESS.md"` in a loop.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copyright 2026 Anthropic PBC
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Commit tracked changes at the end of every session so work is durable across
# restarts. Uses `commit -am` (tracked files only) on purpose: ephemeral
# artifacts (screenshots, logs, scratch files) shouldn't land in history. The
# agent is expected to `git add` new source files itself per CLAUDE.md.
#
# Fails silently if commit can't be made (no git user.name, hook rejects, etc);
# check `git log` periodically when relying on this as a backstop.
if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
    git commit -am "session checkpoint: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
fi
exit 0

# Ship #222 — schema versioning + clean-allow count-bucket compaction (codex T1
# NEEDS-REVISION conf=0.91, applied per Pattern A; verdict at

# Patterns narrowed per codex T1 regex_review (action-deferral verbs + design-surface
# terms only; broad "Do you want?" / "Want me to?" alone do NOT match per codex
# finding 1.3 — Karpathy P1 says ordinary clarification is valid).
ACTION_VERBS = r"(?:run|fire|apply|fix|proceed|continue|do|edit|commit|push|investigate|deploy|implement)"

# All patterns IGNORECASE | MULTILINE per codex T1 round-2 finding F2.
_RX_FLAGS = re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE
ASK_PATTERNS = [
    # "Would you like me to <action-verb>" / "Do you want me to <action-verb>"
    re.compile(rf"\b(?:would|do)\s+you\s+(?:like|want)\s+me\s+to\s+{ACTION_VERBS}\b", _RX_FLAGS),
    # "I can <action-verb> ... if you want/like/prefer"
    re.compile(rf"\bI\s+can\s+{ACTION_VERBS}\s+.{{0,80}}\bif\s+you\s+(?:want|like|prefer|wish)\b",
               _RX_FLAGS | re.DOTALL),
    # "Should I <action-verb>?" / "Shall I <action-verb>?"
    re.compile(rf"\b(?:should|shall)\s+I\s+{ACTION_VERBS}\b", _RX_FLAGS),
    # "Awaiting your direction/input/approval/pick/choice/decision"
    re.compile(r"\bawaiting\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:direction|input|approval|pick|choice|decision|answer)\b",
               _RX_FLAGS),
    # "Please choose/pick/select <option/variant/approach>" / "Let me know which..."
    re.compile(r"\b(?:please\s+)?(?:choose|pick|select|let\s+me\s+know)\s+(?:which|the)\s+"
               r"(?:option|variant|approach|way|fix)\b", _RX_FLAGS),
    # "Reply with A" / "Reply with X (recommended)"
    re.compile(r"\bReply\s+with\s+[A-Z]\b", _RX_FLAGS),
    # "Option A / Option B" or "Variant A / Variant B" — explicit menu
    re.compile(r"\b(?:option|variant)\s+[A-Z]\s*[/|\-]\s*(?:option|variant)\s+[A-Z]\b", _RX_FLAGS),
    # T1-deferral specifically (asking permission to run the already-required gate)
    re.compile(r"\b(?:want\s+me\s+to|should\s+I)\s+(?:fire|run|invoke)\s+(?:codex\s+)?T1\b", _RX_FLAGS),
]

# Markdown table option-menu — header row → separator → 2+ single-letter [A-Z] rows.
# Per codex T1 round-2 finding F4: real menus have header (text words) + separator + A/B/C
# rows. Prior regex required FIRST col to be single-letter A-Z which never matches header.
MENU_TABLE_RE = re.compile(
    r"\|.*?\|.*?\n\|\s*[-:]+\s*\|.*?\n(?:\|\s*[A-Z]\s*\|.*?\n){2,}",
    re.MULTILINE
)


def _strip_noise(text: str) -> str:
    """Remove fenced code blocks, inline code, blockquotes — codex T1 prescribed.

    Avoids false-positives on review excerpts containing "Reply with A" inside
    a code fence or quoted transcript.
    """
    text = re.sub(r"```.*?```", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL)
    text = re.sub(r"`[^`\n]+`", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"^>\s.*$", "", text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    return text


def _detect_ask_pattern(text: str) -> str | None:
    """Return short pattern label or None."""
    cleaned = _strip_noise(text)
    for i, pat in enumerate(ASK_PATTERNS):
        m = pat.search(cleaned)
        if m:
            return f"ASK_{i}:{m.group(0)[:60]}"
    if MENU_TABLE_RE.search(cleaned):
        return "MENU_TABLE"
    return None


def _scan_transcript_last_assistant(transcript_path: str) -> tuple[str, int, str]:
    """Return (last_text, tool_count, parse_status) by scanning transcript JSONL backward.

    Per codex T1 round-2 finding F1: tool_count == -1 sentinel signals "uncertain"
    (parse failed, transcript missing, no entry). Caller MUST require parse_status=='ok'
    before treating tool_count==0 as authoritative; otherwise lenient-mode block-trigger
    fires on uncertainty (= false-positive against Karpathy P1).
    """
    if not transcript_path:
        return ("", -1, "no_transcript_path")
    try:
        path = Path(transcript_path)
        if not path.exists():
            return ("", -1, "transcript_missing")
        with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            lines = fh.readlines()
        for line in reversed(lines):
            try:
                rec = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
            if rec.get("type") == "assistant":
                content = rec.get("content") or rec.get("message", {}).get("content") or []
                if isinstance(content, list):
                    texts = [b.get("text", "") for b in content
                             if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "text"]
                    tools = sum(1 for b in content
                                if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "tool_use")
                    return (" ".join(texts), tools, "ok")
        return ("", -1, "no_assistant_entry")
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — fail-open per codex finding 1.2
        return ("", -1, f"parse_exception:{type(exc).__name__}")


def _check_oneshot_latch(session_id: str, msg_hash: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
    """True if this (session, msg, pattern) triple was already blocked once."""
    if not session_id or not msg_hash:
        return False
    key = f"{session_id}:{msg_hash}:{pattern}"
    try:
        if _ONESHOT_LATCH.exists():
            data = json.loads(_ONESHOT_LATCH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            return key in data.get("blocked_keys", [])
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — latch is best-effort
        return False
    return False


def _record_oneshot_latch(session_id: str, msg_hash: str, pattern: str) -> None:
    """Record (session, msg, pattern) triple as already-blocked. LRU cap 100.

    Cycle 3 ship #3 atomic-write fix: parallel Stop hooks could race on the
    read-modify-write sequence (read JSON → mutate → write back). Without
    atomic temp+rename, second writer clobbers first writer's append. Mirrors
    cycle 2's _persist_diff_hash pattern in codex_stop_review_gate.py.
    """
    if not session_id or not msg_hash:
        return
    key = f"{session_id}:{msg_hash}:{pattern}"
    try:
        _STATE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        data: dict = {"blocked_keys": []}
        if _ONESHOT_LATCH.exists():
            data = json.loads(_ONESHOT_LATCH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if "blocked_keys" not in data:
                data["blocked_keys"] = []
        if key not in data["blocked_keys"]:
            data["blocked_keys"].append(key)
            if len(data["blocked_keys"]) > 100:
                data["blocked_keys"] = data["blocked_keys"][-100:]
        # Atomic write: unique-temp + os.replace prevents concurrent-write
        # corruption (cycle 3 ship #3 / code-reviewer P1-B finding).
        tmp_path = _ONESHOT_LATCH.parent / (
            f"{_ONESHOT_LATCH.name}.{os.getpid()}.{uuid.uuid4().hex}.tmp"
        )
        try:
            tmp_path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(_ONESHOT_LATCH))
        except OSError:
            with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                tmp_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — latch is best-effort + observability
        sys.stderr.write(f"[auto-proceed-gate] latch write failed: {exc!r}\n")


def _append_full_telemetry(record: dict) -> None:
    """Append v1 full row with schema tag (codex T1 F1 P1 — load-bearing decisions)."""
    record.setdefault("schema", _TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_FULL)
    try:
        _STATE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with _TELEMETRY.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — telemetry is best-effort + observability
        sys.stderr.write(f"[auto-proceed-gate] telemetry write failed: {exc!r}\n")


# Backward-compat alias (Ship #220 convention).
_append_telemetry = _append_full_telemetry


def _is_bucketable_allow(record: dict) -> bool:
    """Codex T1 F1 P1: only the dominant clean allow_no_pattern class is bucket-safe.

    Mixed-mode allows / no-assistant-text fail-open / parse-uncertain / recursion-latch
    are gate-health signals that MUST keep per-fire audit trail.
    """
    return (
        record.get("decision") == "allow"
        and record.get("diag") == "allow_no_pattern"
        and record.get("matched_pattern") is None
        and record.get("tool_parse_status") == "ok"
        and record.get("dry_run") is False
    )


def _date_hour_now() -> str:
    """UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH bucket key (1-hour aggregation window)."""
    return datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H")


def _bucket_lock_path(date_hour: str) -> Path:
    return _ALLOW_BUCKET_DIR / f"lock-{date_hour}.lock"


def _bucket_pending_path(date_hour: str) -> Path:
    return _ALLOW_BUCKET_DIR / f"pending-{date_hour}.json"


def _with_bucket_lock(lock_path: Path, fn) -> bool:
    """Execute fn() under O_CREAT|O_EXCL lock; bounded retry (5s deadline / 50ms backoff)."""
    deadline = time.time() + 5.0
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            fd = os.open(str(lock_path), os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o644)
            try:
                os.write(fd, str(os.getpid()).encode("utf-8"))
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
            try:
                fn()
            finally:
                with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                    lock_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            return True
        except FileExistsError:
            time.sleep(0.05)
        except OSError:
            return False
    return False


def _empty_pending_bucket(date_hour: str) -> dict:
    return {
        "schema": _TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_BUCKET_PENDING,
        "date_hour": date_hour,
        "decision": "allow",
        "first_ts": None,
        "last_ts": None,
        "entries": [],
    }


def _load_pending_bucket(path: Path, date_hour: str) -> dict:
    if not path.is_file():
        return _empty_pending_bucket(date_hour)
    try:
        with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            data = json.load(fh)
        if isinstance(data, dict) and isinstance(data.get("entries"), list):
            return data
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        pass
    return _empty_pending_bucket(date_hour)


def _write_pending_bucket_atomic(path: Path, bucket: dict) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    try:
        with tmp.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            json.dump(bucket, fh, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
        os.replace(str(tmp), str(path))
    except OSError:
        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
            tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def _latency_histogram_bin(latency_ms: int) -> str:
    """Codex T1 F4: 4-bin fixed histogram preserves regression signal."""
    if latency_ms < 100:
        return "lt100"
    if latency_ms < 500:
        return "100_499"
    if latency_ms < 1000:
        return "500_999"
    return "gte1000"


def _increment_allow_bucket(bucket: dict, entry: dict) -> dict:
    """Find matching entry by 9-tuple key (codex T1 F2 P1 + F3 P2 attribution invariants)."""
    key_fields = (
        "diag", "mode", "dry_run", "tool_parse_status", "stop_hook_active",
        "tool_count_class", "session_id", "agent_id", "agent_type",
    )
    new_key = tuple(entry.get(k) for k in key_fields)
    ts = entry["ts"]
    latency = int(entry.get("latency_ms", 0))
    bucket["last_ts"] = ts
    if bucket["first_ts"] is None:
        bucket["first_ts"] = ts
    bin_key = _latency_histogram_bin(latency)
    for existing in bucket["entries"]:
        if tuple(existing.get(k) for k in key_fields) == new_key:
            existing["count"] = existing.get("count", 0) + 1
            existing["last_ts"] = ts
            existing["latency_ms_count"] = existing.get("latency_ms_count", 0) + 1
            existing["latency_ms_sum"] = existing.get("latency_ms_sum", 0) + latency
            existing["latency_ms_min"] = min(existing.get("latency_ms_min", latency), latency)
            existing["latency_ms_max"] = max(existing.get("latency_ms_max", latency), latency)
            hist = existing.setdefault("latency_ms_histogram", {"lt100": 0, "100_499": 0, "500_999": 0, "gte1000": 0})
            hist[bin_key] = hist.get(bin_key, 0) + 1
            return bucket
    new_entry = {k: entry.get(k) for k in key_fields}
    new_entry.update({
        "count": 1,
        "first_ts": ts,
        "last_ts": ts,
        "latency_ms_count": 1,
        "latency_ms_sum": latency,
        "latency_ms_min": latency,
        "latency_ms_max": latency,
        "latency_ms_histogram": {"lt100": 0, "100_499": 0, "500_999": 0, "gte1000": 0},
    })
    new_entry["latency_ms_histogram"][bin_key] = 1
    bucket["entries"].append(new_entry)
    return bucket


def _flush_allow_bucket_if_due(date_hour: str, now_ts: float) -> None:
    """Flush pending bucket → JSONL row if older than _ALLOW_BUCKET_FLUSH_INTERVAL_SEC. Idempotent."""
    pending_path = _bucket_pending_path(date_hour)
    if not pending_path.is_file():
        return
    try:
        mtime = pending_path.stat().st_mtime
    except OSError:
        return
    if now_ts - mtime < _ALLOW_BUCKET_FLUSH_INTERVAL_SEC:
        return
    lock_path = _bucket_lock_path(date_hour)

    def _do_flush():
        if not pending_path.is_file():
            return
        try:
            with pending_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                bucket = json.load(fh)
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            return
        flushed = {
            "schema": _TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_BUCKET,
            "ts": datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
            "date_hour": bucket.get("date_hour"),
            "decision": "allow",
            "first_ts": bucket.get("first_ts"),
            "last_ts": bucket.get("last_ts"),
            "entries": bucket.get("entries", []),
        }
        try:
            _STATE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with _TELEMETRY.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                fh.write(json.dumps(flushed, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            pending_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            pass

    _with_bucket_lock(lock_path, _do_flush)


def _record_allow_bucket(record: dict) -> None:
    """Update on-disk pending bucket atomically; never write to _TELEMETRY inline."""
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    date_hour = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H")
    pending_path = _bucket_pending_path(date_hour)
    lock_path = _bucket_lock_path(date_hour)
    entry = dict(record)
    entry["ts"] = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    def _do_update():
        bucket = _load_pending_bucket(pending_path, date_hour)
        bucket = _increment_allow_bucket(bucket, entry)
        _write_pending_bucket_atomic(pending_path, bucket)

    _with_bucket_lock(lock_path, _do_update)
    _flush_allow_bucket_if_due(date_hour, time.time())


def _emit_telemetry(record: dict) -> None:
    """Schema-aware dispatch: bucket clean allow_no_pattern; full-row everything else."""
    if _is_bucketable_allow(record):
        _record_allow_bucket(record)
    else:
        _append_full_telemetry(record)


def main() -> int:
    started = time.time()

    if os.environ.get(DISABLE_ENV) == "1":
        return 0

    payload = parse_hook_payload("auto_proceed_gate") or {}
    stop_hook_active = bool(payload.get("stop_hook_active"))
    session_id = payload.get("session_id", "")
    transcript_path = payload.get("transcript_path", "")
    # Ship #222 F2 P1: extract agent_id/agent_type for parallel-agent attribution
    # per audit-action-loop.md hook telemetry contract.
    agent_id = payload.get("agent_id") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
    agent_type = payload.get("agent_type") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None

    # Prefer payload's last_assistant_message (per codex finding 1.2)
    last_text = payload.get("last_assistant_message", "") or ""
    tool_count = -1  # sentinel: unknown
    tool_parse_status = "payload_text_only"

    if not last_text:
        # Fallback: scan transcript JSONL
        last_text, tool_count, tool_parse_status = _scan_transcript_last_assistant(transcript_path)
    else:
        # Have payload text; still need tool_count from transcript
        _, tool_count, tool_parse_status = _scan_transcript_last_assistant(transcript_path)

    if not last_text:
        # Ship #222 F1 P1: no_assistant_text is a gate-health signal, NOT bucket-eligible.
        # Routes through _emit_telemetry which schema-tags as apg.v1.full per dispatch.
        _emit_telemetry({
            "ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
            "decision": "allow", "matched_pattern": None,
            "tool_count": tool_count, "tool_parse_status": tool_parse_status,
            "stop_hook_active": stop_hook_active, "mode": "n/a",
            "dry_run": False,
            "session_id": session_id, "agent_id": agent_id, "agent_type": agent_type,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - started) * 1000),
            "diag": "no_assistant_text",
        })
        return 0

    matched = _detect_ask_pattern(last_text)
    strict_mode = os.environ.get(STRICT_ENV) == "1"
    dry_run = os.environ.get(DRY_RUN_ENV) == "1"
    msg_hash = hashlib.sha256(last_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]

    # Decision matrix per codex T1 verdict + round-2 F1 fix:
    # block in lenient mode requires AUTHORITATIVE zero (parse_status='ok' AND tool_count==0).
    # Uncertain transcript states (parse_status != 'ok' OR tool_count == -1 sentinel) → allow.
    decision = "allow"
    reason = ""
    authoritative_zero = (tool_parse_status == "ok") and (tool_count == 0)
    block_trigger = bool(matched) and (strict_mode or authoritative_zero)

    # Ship #222 F1 P1: structured `diag` enum (machine-key for bucket dedupe);
    # human `reason` retained ONLY for stdout block payload (preserves prior UX).
    diag = ""
    if block_trigger:
        # Recursion guard (codex finding 1.1)
        if stop_hook_active and _check_oneshot_latch(session_id, msg_hash, matched):
            decision = "allow"
            diag = "recursion_guard_already_blocked"
            reason = f"recursion_guard_already_blocked: pattern={matched}"
        else:
            decision = "block"
            diag = "block_pattern_matched"
            reason = (
                f"auto-proceed-gate: ask-without-act detected "
                f"(pattern={matched}, tool_count={tool_count}, "
                f"mode={'strict' if strict_mode else 'lenient'}). "
                "Per CLAUDE.md cardinal rule #3 + memory/feedback_auto_deep_dive_no_pause.md, "
                "this harness's gate IS codex T1 — write "
                ".claude/state/codex_consult_<topic>.txt with primary-source cites, "
                "pipe to `codex exec --ephemeral -p deep-review --skip-git-repo-check`, "
                "apply per verdict. For genuine round-5+ blockers, follow "
                ".claude/rules/closed-loop-recursive-narrowing.md terminal disposition "
                "(Outcome A ACCEPT-WITH-DOC / B REVERT-AND-REMOVE / C MANUAL-OVERRIDE). "
                "Operator escape: AUTO_PROCEED_GATE_DISABLE=1."
            )
            if not dry_run:
                _record_oneshot_latch(session_id, msg_hash, matched)
    else:
        if matched:
            diag = "allow_mixed_mode"
            reason = f"allow_mixed_mode: pattern={matched} but tool_count={tool_count}"
        else:
            diag = "allow_no_pattern"
            reason = "allow_no_pattern"

    # Ship #222 F3 P2: tool_count_class is bucket-key dimension (preserves parse-health
    # signal without per-fire timestamps). 3-bin: zero / nonzero / unknown.
    tool_count_class = (
        "zero" if tool_count == 0
        else "unknown" if tool_count == -1
        else "nonzero"
    )
    _emit_telemetry({
        "ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
        "decision": decision,
        "matched_pattern": matched,
        "tool_count": tool_count,
        "tool_count_class": tool_count_class,
        "tool_parse_status": tool_parse_status,
        "stop_hook_active": stop_hook_active,
        "mode": "strict" if strict_mode else "lenient",
        "dry_run": dry_run,
        "msg_hash": msg_hash,
        "session_id": session_id,
        "agent_id": agent_id,
        "agent_type": agent_type,
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - started) * 1000),
        "diag": diag,
        "reason": reason[:300] if decision == "block" else None,  # human reason only on block
    })

    if decision == "block" and not dry_run:
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps({"decision": "block", "reason": reason}))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents\README.md:58:A fresh session has no memory of what the previous one did, and when a long session fills its context window Claude Code summarizes the history, which loses detail. So the agent maintains the handoff itself: it scopes each session to one feature, writes to a structured `PROGRESS.md` as it works and re-reads it first thing on every restart, and `git add`s and commits at meaningful checkpoints so `git log` is a second record. `commit-on-stop.sh` is the backstop that catches whatever's still uncommitted at session end. Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:1:# Harness Primitives for Long-Running Claude Agents
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:2:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:3:An agent you can leave running for hours needs more than a good prompt. It needs a small amount of structure around it: enforcement that "done" means observed evidence, an independent check on its own claims, and a way for the next session to pick up cleanly where this one left off. [Effective Harnesses for Long-Running Agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-harnesses-for-long-running-agents) (Nov 2025) and [Harness Design for Long-Running Application Development](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/harness-design-long-running-apps) (Mar 2026) describe these patterns; this repo is the code companion. It ships a short, readable example of each as a native [Claude Code hook](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks) or subagent, so you can see the mechanism, copy what fits, and wire it into your own harness.
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:4:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:5:Three primitives form the quality loop:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:6:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:7:- **Default-FAIL contract.** Every criterion starts `false`; the agent can't mark it passing without opening evidence first.
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:8:- **Fresh-context evaluator.** A separate agent with no Write/Edit tools grades the work from a context window that never saw the build.
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:9:- **Agent-maintained handoff.** The agent writes its own progress notes and commits to git so the next session picks up cleanly.
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:10:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:11:Two more operator-control hooks are included for when you want to watch or intervene. The same patterns translate directly to `PreToolUse`/`Stop` callbacks in the [Agent SDK](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/sdk).
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:12:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:13:> Built as the take-home for the Long-Running Agents station at Code with Claude 2026. **These are example ingredients, not a turnkey harness.** Event demo; not maintained and not accepting contributions.

Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:35:

Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:41:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:42:### Default-FAIL contract
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:43:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:44:Agents will mark a feature "passing" after a unit test or a curl when the UI is visibly broken. Asking nicely in the prompt doesn't reliably stop this. The harness makes "done" structural. Every feature is a row in a `test-results.json` file you create in your project:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:45:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:46:```json
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:47:{ "feature-1": { "passes": false }, "feature-2": { "passes": false } }
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:48:```
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:49:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:50:The only evidence that counts is a file matching the patterns in `track-read.sh` (screenshots, console logs, result files), and a `PreToolUse` hook denies any write to the results file unless the agent has first opened one with the Read tool. The agent can't claim success it hasn't observed. (The shipped hook is intentionally simple; see the comments in `verify-gate.sh` for the gaps a production version would close.)
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:51:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:52:### Fresh-context evaluator
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:53:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:54:The builder shouldn't grade its own work. After each feature, you (or your wrapper script) invoke a separate subagent (`agents/evaluator.md`) with no Write/Edit tools that reviews the diff and the screenshots from a context window that never saw the build, then returns `PASS` or `NEEDS_WORK` with specific findings. On `NEEDS_WORK` the findings become the next builder session's starting prompt, closing the build/evaluate/rebuild loop. Invoke it from your wrapper with `claude --agent evaluator -p "<review prompt>"`; what your loop does with the verdict is up to you.
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:55:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:56:### Agent-maintained handoff
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:57:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:58:A fresh session has no memory of what the previous one did, and when a long session fills its context window Claude Code summarizes the history, which loses detail. So the agent maintains the handoff itself: it scopes each session to one feature, writes to a structured `PROGRESS.md` as it works and re-reads it first thing on every restart, and `git add`s and commits at meaningful checkpoints so `git log` is a second record. `commit-on-stop.sh` is the backstop that catches whatever's still uncommitted at session end. This is the layer most sensitive to model capability; newer models drift less and self-scope better, so re-evaluate how much of `CLAUDE.md` you still need after each model release (see [Re-simplify on model upgrades](#going-further)).
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:59:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:60:A fourth core piece, a **rubric for subjective work**, isn't shipped here because it's project-specific; see [Going further](#going-further) for how to add one to the evaluator.
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:61:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:62:## Operator controls
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:63:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:64:Two more hooks for when you want to watch the loop run or intervene mid-stream. These aren't part of the quality story; they're how a human stays in the loop.
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:65:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:66:| Hook | What it does |
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:67:|---|---|
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:68:| [`hooks/kill-switch.sh`](./claude-code-config/.claude/hooks/kill-switch.sh) | Halts every tool call while an `AGENT_STOP` file exists at the project root. |
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:69:| [`hooks/steer.sh`](./claude-code-config/.claude/hooks/steer.sh) | Surfaces the contents of `STEER.md` (project root) to the agent once and clears it, so you can redirect mid-run without restarting. |
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:70:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:71:## Watching it work
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:72:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:73:Everything the agent does lands on disk, so you can observe a long run from a terminal without any dashboard code:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:74:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:75:```bash
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:76:watch -n 2 'tail -20 PROGRESS.md'                          # its own notes
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:77:watch -n 5 'git log --oneline -8'                          # work saved
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:78:watch -n 5 'find screenshots -name "*.png" | tail -5'      # what it sees
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:79:watch -n 2 'wc -l < .claude/.evidence-reads 2>/dev/null'   # evidence reads (resets to 0 after each gated write)
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:80:```
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:81:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:82:Run them in a `tmux` grid and you have a live view of every primitive.
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:83:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:84:## Going further
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:85:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:86:The next layer of patterns, each covered in depth in [Harness Design for Long-Running Application Development](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/harness-design-long-running-apps):
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:87:
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:88:| Pattern | What it adds | Reference |
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:89:|---|---|---|
Z:/repos/deps/cwc-long-running-agents/README.md:90:| **Unattended loop** | Cap session length and have an outer script start the next one (pick next feature, build, evaluate, reset) | [Why naive implementations fall short](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/harness-design-long-running-apps#why-naive-implementations-fall-short); [`ralph-loop`](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official/tree/main/plugins/ralph-loop) plugin |

.local/cwc\README.md:58:A fresh session has no memory of what the previous one did, and when a long session fills its context window Claude Code summarizes the history, which loses detail. So the agent maintains the handoff itself: it scopes each session to one feature, writes to a structured `PROGRESS.md` as it works and re-reads it first thing on every restart, and `git add`s and commits at meaningful checkpoints so `git log` is a second record. `commit-on-stop.sh` is the backstop that catches whatever's still uncommitted at session end. This is the layer most sensitive to model capability; newer models drift less and self-scope better, so re-evaluate how much of `CLAUDE.md` you still need after each model release (see [Re-simplify on model upgrades](#going-further)).
